Title: Aditya's Day

Cast

1. Aditya - 12 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Anjali - 37 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The bedroom - a big bed, a wooden cupboard
3. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Aditya stands in the living room. Anjali stands near him.]

Aditya: "What lovely weather!"

[Aditya sweeps the floor with a broom.]

Anjali (surprised): "Okay, Aditya."

[Aditya mops the floor.]

Aditya: "Hey, look at that!"

[Aditya irons his school shirt.]

Aditya: "I'm ready!"

Scene 2: The bedroom - Day

Anjali: "Aditya, look over here."

[Aditya stretches his arms above his head.]

Aditya: "Really?"

[Aditya goes to bed and falls asleep.]

Aditya: "Hey, look at that!"

Scene 3: The courtyard - Day

Aditya: "Mom, look over here."

[It starts to rain.]

Aditya: "Yes, all right."

[A light drizzle begins.]

Aditya: "Yes, all right."

[A cool breeze blows through the courtyard.]

Aditya: "What a day to remember!"
